violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CHICKEN SANDWICHES IN THE LEFT 1-DOOR HOTBOX AT 105-111F AND CHICKEN SANDWICHES AT 88-109F IN THE RIGHT 1-DOOR HOTBOX.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED ALL SANDWICHES DURING THE INSPECTION AND WILL REVIEW PROPER HOT HOLDING PROCEDURES WITH STAFF.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED OPENED, COOKED CHICKPEAS 49-60F IN A COUNTER COOLER. PIC STATED CHICKPEAS WERE TAKEN FROM A COOLER WHICH WAS AT ~68F BECAUSE THE DOOR WAS LEFT OPEN.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CHICKPEAS DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED REHEATED COMMERCIAL PERSONAL PIZZAS IN WALK-IN COOLER WITH A BAG OVER THE RACK. THE BAG COLLECTED MOISTURE AND PIZZA WAS AT ~60F.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI: PIZZA UNCOVERED. PIC RE-EDUCATED. PLEASE USE ANY OF THE ABOVE METHODS TO COOL TCS FOODS WITHIN THE REQUIRED TIME CONSTRAINTS.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink, located by the dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: The food service employee replaced the paper towels at the handwashing sink during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: EHS observed that the hot water at the 3 vat sink registered at 77F, at the hottest temperature. The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM put in a work order for the repairs of the hot water at the 3 vat sink, during the inspection. The CFM will need to provide proof of corrected temperature to the EHS for a follow up within 10 days.
